steps.text: TOOLS BUG-2b (FIX_PLAN_v2 TOOLS: scanner microprint, deferred to #13): at A2, on a planted ReprintedPaper case (re-enabled at #17; until then any paper that prints a microprint line), scan the paper, open the scan view's UV layer (UI-PC's ScanLayerSwitch prints the line with MicroprintView.Print), then measure. Pass: tools.micro.*.cap >=12 px (MicroprintView.CapPx, measured from the drawn glyphs) and tools.micro.*.credited (DeskReadings.MicroRead) only after the layer rendered. Retarget 'MicroprintRow' to the object UI-PC names at #13; 'n' is the paper's index in the case.
UI-PC #13: drag the paper onto the scanner, open its copy on the PC, click the UV tab (ScanLayerSwitch.Select(ScanLayer.Uv)).
